summary: Master brand strategy and positioning with audits, positioning statements, and brand equity tools. Enrol to build a sharper brand roadmap.
lede: Brand positioning training helps brand and marketing professionals turn market and customer insight into a clear, defensible position for their organization. Through practical exercises, they conduct brand audits using SWOT and perceptual mapping, create positioning statements and messaging frameworks, and build brand equity scorecards and roadmaps to guide execution.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already influence brand decisions and need a practical framework for brand strategy and positioning. It fits hands-on brand operators, managers, analysts, and leaders who work across messaging, identity, equity, and portfolio decisions. Brand Managers who need sharper positioning and governance. Marketing Managers responsible for brand consistency and campaign direction. Product Marketers shaping category claims and launch messaging. Communications Managers aligning internal and external brand voice. Corporate Communications Leads managing reputation and message control. Digital Marketing Managers coordinating brand consistency across channels. Marketing Directors reporting brand performance to senior leadership. Product Portfolio Managers deciding sub-brand and extension structures. Customer Experience Managers linking brand promise to service delivery. Strategy Leads who need evidence-based brand direction.
prerequisites: You should arrive with a laptop and working access to common office software for workshop exercises. Bring any available brand guidelines, campaign examples, audience research, competitor references, and recent brand performance reports so you can complete the applied deliverables.
